title: Ordinary direct-image evaluation for compact support
statement:
theorem compactSupportDirectImageOrdinaryEvaluation
    {Z Y : Scheme.{t}} (p : Z ⟶ Y) :
    ∃ (ordinary : ∀ n : ℕ,
        integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage l E p ⋙ coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n ≅
          coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Z n ⋙ compactSupportLevelDirectImage l E p n),
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (N : coefficientSequenceModules l E Z) (V : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (x : ((integralComparisonSequenceDirectImage l E p ⋙
          coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E Y n).obj N).val.obj V),
        HEq (((ordinary n).hom.app N).val.app V x) x

source.place: Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10; decomposition of the parent proof into ordinary and derived components

proof.text: For each n use the canonical ring-identification maps a and b from evaluation of the sequence ring to the finite coefficient sheaves. At each pro-etale object their components are identities. The system direct-image ring map at (n,U) is definitionally the finite constant-section ring map at U, so the square of ring maps commutes. Apply Mathlib SheafOfModules.pushforwardComp on the two sides and SheafOfModules.pushforwardCongr to this equality to obtain the ordinary natural isomorphism.
Every component of pushforwardComp and pushforwardCongr is the identity on underlying sections. Their composite therefore sends x to x, proving the required HEq normalization for all n, N, V and x.

proof_origin.place: Construction 4.1 and Lemma 4.10; explicit ringed-site pushforward composition using Mathlib SheafOfModules.pushforwardComp and pushforwardCongr (R2, 2026-10-27).
